source: BMA planning zone and OpenStreetMap contributors. OSM data licensed under ODbL 1.0.
notes: Zone Y.3-29 is an official BMA planning boundary: FAR 2.5, OSR 12.5%. Zero height and setback attributes do not grant unrestricted development.
Hypothetical redevelopment study boundary only, not surveyed, cadastral, ownership or title evidence.
Legal road width is editable and starts at a 20 m scenario value. Public-road access is assumed and unverified. OSM centerlines do not verify legal right of way, frontage or access.
Building heights: explicit height tags when present; levels multiplied by 3 m where tagged; otherwise an illustrative 9 m default. No default is a measured height.
OSM data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Building and road way identifiers and edit timestamps preserved.
BMA reuse license has not been verified. Review the source license before external publication.
Local extract covers about 1.1 km square. A closed OSM building way may extend outside the requested bounding box.

Default study plot is a hypothetical unsurveyed redevelopment boundary beside mapped Soi Hathai Rat 29/1, OSM way 653459414. Its 20 m road width and public access are scenario assumptions. The surrounding mapped buildings supply neighborhood context, not surveyed clearance evidence.

validation.method: JSTS validity and full-polygon containment after projected conversion; not a survey.
